name: macos-dev-workflow
description: Development workflow for macOS and iOS apps. Installs the core workflow and adds the Apple platform skills (axiom, swift-concurrency, swift-testing-pro), with hooks that make the workflow's agents use them: a start hint naming the skills, and a stop check that sends an implementer or standards reviewer back when its files need a skill it never invoked (routing in hooks/skill-routing.json).
